g.text: Why not just IDs? Three weaknesses of ID embeddings
A new item has no interactions yet, so its ID embedding is random: it cannot beat old, hot items.
Once an item is no longer distributed, everything its embedding learned is thrown away ('knowledge isolation').
An LLM reads the title and the images, so it knows what a new item is on day one.
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559), §1 and Figure 1. Vocabulary size: '< 20,000 token IDs' in the text, '~1e5' in Figure 1
